notes.subject: יחבוש
notes.rationale: Root is 'wrap/bind firmly' (as a bandage or turban); most read 'govern/restrain' — Tok Pisin 'bosim' follows the governing sense.

notes.subject: כביר
notes.rationale: 'vast/mighty' — does it modify the righteous one ('righteous and mighty', KJV/JPS) or is it a title 'the Most Just' (YLT)?

notes.subject: to Iyov
notes.rationale: Elihu's second-person challenge: 'wilt thou condemn the just one?' addresses Iyov directly.

translation: Inap, man i birua long kot i ken bosim? Na yu ken skelim em i nogut — em i man stret we i gat bikpela strong?
